artboards.title: WORLD dock — Option A: one column
WORLD dock — Option B: A/B switch

annotations.text:
TWO THINGS ONLY YOU CAN SETTLE.

1. WORLD dock — A or B. Same content twice. A drops the mode switch and scrolls; B restores the two-segment pill. B's two captions are DERIVED, not read: the originals sit in the truncated tail of the spec and cannot be recovered.

2. Timeline — the year scrubber as the timeline bar's expanded state, per your ruling. Collapsed and expanded are both drawn.

REVIEW THE LAYOUT, NOT THE VALUES.

A design critic opened all thirteen boards and found factual errors in seven of them — a wrong swatch hex, a missing GeoJSON layer, live readouts for bindings that do not exist. Those are listed in the chat and queued as a fix pass.

What I need from you here is composition and direction. A wrong hex does not change whether the window is laid out right.

Thumb-reachable bottom cluster, per your ruling — drawn over a map in both the default and sheet-open states, because the bottom sheet competes for exactly that band.

The generation-failure and storage-full states had no design at all. The critic rated these the most rigorously source-checked boards in the round.

Four surfaces the design set never drew.

The Layers popover has one job worth checking: the Colour relief row is currently a live control over a layer that draws nothing at its shipped default. The design has to tell that truth rather than leave a dead row looking alive.
